purpose: Soil classification with pH band, texture, state distribution and crop suitability.
collection_mode: Knowledge synthesis from documented public sources (WebFetch to government domains blocked by environment egress policy)
methodology: Ten soil classes were taken from the ICAR-NBSS&LUP national classification, retaining the four problem-soil classes (saline, acidic, alkaline, clay) because reclamation and crop-choice decisions depend on them.
known_limitations: pH bands are typical ranges, not guarantees; field pH varies within a single parcel. Composite textures used in crops.soil_type_preferred (for example sandy loam) are deliberately not separate soil_id rows.
